notes: «كلاهما عن عبد الوارث» and «قال شيبان حدثنا عبد الوارث» name the same man twice in succession, so he is one link (rule 7)
«عن أبي التياح، عن أنس» is written once after the two shaykhs meet, so it is the shared tail (rule 3)
Anas is the Companion who describes the Prophet's conduct, so he is the last link
